# Groq free tier limits
The openai SDK works with Groq via base_url, but the article omits that you must use from groq import Groq instead for proper Groq-specific features and error handling - the openai.OpenAI client with base_url is a workaround, not the native approach. Groq free tier limits are 10,000 requests/month and 5 million tokens/month combined across all models; exceeding either triggers immediate 429 errors with no partial request - there is no graceful degradation

# Groq Free Tier
## Free Tier Details
**Free Tier**: No credits system — free access gated only by rate limits
**Rate Limits**: ~30 req/min, ~14,400 req/day; per-model token limits (e.g. ~12K tokens/min on Llama 3.3 70B)
**Models Available**: All models (Llama, GPT-OSS, Whisper, etc.)
**Credit Card Required**: No — adding a card unlocks the Developer tier (~10x limits + 25% discount, no minimum spend)

### Three tiers govern access and rates:
- **Groq free tier.** Every model, no credit card. Rate-limited to 30 requests per minute, 6,000 tokens per minute, and 14,400 requests per day. Limits apply at the organization level, multiple API keys don’t help. Enough for prototyping. Nowhere near enough for production
